The visibility change of the `user` field to `protected` (#JRWF3) is necessary for subclasses to access it when creating redacted copies in `dropLargeFields`.
The implementation follows existing XContent patterns used within the project.
Unit tests in `HistoryStoreTests` (#2MPQS) cover edge cases including null inputs/results and different record types (`MessageWatchRecord` vs `ExceptionWatchRecord`).
The integration test `testThatHistoryIsTruncated` (#21BPQ) correctly verifies both the positive case (small records remain intact) and the negative case (large records are truncated).

The addition of `.addSort("@timestamp", SortOrder.ASC)` in `getWatchHistory` (#7CP4H) is a critical fix for test stability, ensuring that assertions on specific hit indices (`getAt(0)`, `getAt(1)`) are deterministic.

In `HistoryStore#put` (#3TRGR), the record is serialized first to check its actual byte size before deciding whether to redact it. This ensures that only records that actually exceed the limit are processed for truncation.

The use of anonymous inner classes in `getTruncatedInput()` and `getTruncatedWatchExecutionResult()` (#CYM98) effectively creates "read-only" versions of these objects that produce a specific "truncated" message during serialization without altering the original record's state.
Null safety is handled correctly: `dropLargeFields` implementations in `MessageWatchRecord` and `ExceptionWatchRecord` check for nullity of `input` and `executionResult` before calling the truncation helpers.
While records exceeding the limit are serialized twice (once to check size, once after redaction), this is an acceptable trade-off given that these cases are exceptional and the alternative is a failed index request or cluster instability due to oversized documents.

review_comment: I'm also assuming that adding a new field to the history store doesn't need any further changes to mappings or anything?

It looks like `input` doesn't specify dynamic, so it defaults to dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L108). And `result` is explicitly dynamic (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/template-resources/src/main/resources/watch-history.json#L136).
